requirements.en: Collect tree-tag, location and diameter observations using an established field protocol.
requirements.zh: 按既定现场规程采集树木挂牌编号、位置及直径观察数据。

requirements.en: Check inventory records for duplicate identifiers and retain evidence for authorized corrections.
requirements.zh: 检查清查记录中的重复编号，并为获准的更正保留依据。

requirements.en: Communicate with park visitors and recognize which condition questions require arborist review.
requirements.zh: 与公园游客沟通，并识别哪些树况问题须由树艺师审核。

requirements.en: Preferred: hold a professional arborist credential and independently assign tree-risk ratings.
requirements.zh: 优先：持有专业树艺师资格，并能够独立确定树木风险评级。
